hints.title: The predict step
hints.content: In the update() method, first grow uncertainty: `p = p + q;`. This reflects that the true state may have drifted since the last measurement.

hints.title: The update step
hints.content: Compute the Kalman gain: `double k = p / (p + r);`. Then blend estimate toward the measurement: `x = x + k * (measurement - x);`. Finally shrink uncertainty: `p = (1.0 - k) * p;`

hints.title: Using the filtered heading
hints.content: After `filter.update(rawHeading)`, get the result with `filter.getEstimate()`. Use it for heading hold the same way as a raw IMU reading: `error = targetHeading - filteredHeading;`
